name: MsoTextStrike
description: Indicates the number of times a character is printed to darken the image.

constants.name: msoStrikeMixed
constants.description: Specifies that the text can contain a combination of doublestrike and single strike characters.

constants.name: msoNoStrike
constants.description: Specifies that the character is not printed.

constants.name: msoSingleStrike
constants.description: Specifies that the character is printed once.

constants.name: msoDoubleStrike
constants.description: Specifies that the character is printed twice.
